F-P0-foundation.summary: Locked Python/FastAPI skeleton with a truthful /healthz, tests and docs.

F-P1-analysis.summary: Generic extraction and a full page inventory over real source bytes, through one analysis service shared by the app and the evaluation wrapper. Classification and self-check wait for authorized inference.

F-P2-state-boundary.summary: The state and external boundary: a sealed source uploaded directly to R2, a revision store, policy validation, saved versus working state, review and approval bound to a saved revision, a signing adapter with no side effects, and uncertain-operation handling.

F-P3-core-ui.summary: The selected core interface (PR4, feat/studio-core-ui): library, setup, analyzing, editor and record screens translated from the approved design-import rows, with real upload, analysis, save, review and approval, and a simulated create. No login screen, model UI or fixture fields.

F-P3-solution-brief.summary: The public solution brief for Vercel's assessment: a static page under solution-brief/, served by its own Vercel project. The PDF and check outputs stay out of Git. It does not change the app.

F-P4a-model-decision.summary: The baseline comparison and model decision (stage 5): a head-to-head of Alex's claude.ai skill and the app's stage B draft on his own holdout documents, under a plan frozen before any trial. The trials, answer key and scores stay outside the repository; the repository records the outcome and the decision. No app change.

F-P4b-release-evidence.summary: Release evidence and the fixes from the final validation of main at 3f03aa8 (stage 6): pages the AI never checked carry forward and block approval until each is acknowledged by hand, review confirmation covers every page, a draft stops when its drafting configuration changes, plain save-failure and bad-PDF messages, the editor's page rail at 1024 px, and the hosted ledger's opening balance. Each fix has a test.

F-P4d-docs.summary: Approved by Alex on October 15, 2026, after the demo: the project guide becomes a short guide to the current rules and state, with the decisions and the revision history in their own files, and each change is described in its own dated note under docs/changes/.

F-P4e-browser-tests.summary: Approved by Alex on October 15, 2026, after the demo: browser tests (Playwright) drive the local studio through setup, analyzing and the editor with synthetic PDFs. CI's browser job runs them; elsewhere they skip unless STUDIO_E2E=1.

F-P4f-frontend-tidy.summary: Approved by Alex on October 15, 2026, after the demo: the plain-JS frontend is tidied in place: shared helpers instead of copies, no bundler and no framework switch, with the browser tests as the safety net.

F-P4g-inference.summary: Approved by Alex on October 15, 2026, after the demo: drafting changes measured offline first, starting with running the visual self-check (stage B) only on pages where the model drafted fields. Paid trials need Alex's approval.
